tiles.title: Average Request Duration
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0), 2) AS avg_ms
FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status'

tiles.title: P95 Request Duration
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status'

tiles.title: Successful Requests
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (
  WHERE ("http.status_code" LIKE '2%' OR "http.status_code" LIKE '3%') AND span_status_code <> 2
) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_pct
FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status'

tiles.title: Error Requests
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS errors FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status'  AND (
  "http.status_code" LIKE '4%'
  OR "http.status_code" LIKE '5%'
  OR "http.status_code" = '0'
  OR span_status_code = 2
)

tiles.title: Page-context Requests Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:

  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status'

tiles.title: Recent Page View Metrics
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp, "page.path" AS page, "page.url" AS url,
  COALESCE("page.referrer", 'direct') AS referrer,
  COALESCE("navigation.type", 'initial') AS navigation_type,
  data_point_value AS value
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE metric_name = 'page_views'
  AND COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
  AND COALESCE("page.path", 'unknown') ~ '$page'
  AND COALESCE("page.referrer", '') ~ '$referrer'
  AND COALESCE("navigation.type", '') ~ '$navigation'
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Error Rate Over Time

  "http.status_code" LIKE '4%'

)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct

tiles.title: Status Classes Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "http.status_code" LIKE '2%') AS success_2xx,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "http.status_code" LIKE '3%') AS redirect_3xx,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "http.status_code" LIKE '4%') AS client_error_4xx,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "http.status_code" LIKE '5%') AS server_error_5xx,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "http.status_code" = '0') AS network_error
FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status' 
GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

tiles.title: Host Reliability
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT "http.host" AS host, COUNT(*) AS requests,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE (
  "http.status_code" LIKE '4%'
  OR "http.status_code" LIKE '5%'
  OR "http.status_code" = '0'
  OR span_status_code = 2
)) AS errors,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT (
  "http.status_code" LIKE '4%'
  OR "http.status_code" LIKE '5%'
  OR "http.status_code" = '0'
  OR span_status_code = 2
)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_pct,
  ROUND(approx_percentile_cont(span_duration_ns / 1000000.0, 0.95), 2) AS p95_ms
FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status'  AND "http.host" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY host ORDER BY errors DESC, p95_ms DESC

tiles.title: Request Duration Distribution
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH spans AS (
  SELECT span_duration_ns / 1000000.0 AS request_ms FROM $trace_dataset WHERE "deployment.environment" ~ '$environment'
  AND "service.name" ~ '$service'
  AND "page.path" ~ '$page'
  AND "http.host" ~ '$host'
  AND "http.method" ~ '$method'
  AND "http.status_code" ~ '$status' 
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN request_ms < 100 THEN '<100 ms'
  WHEN request_ms < 250 THEN '100-249 ms'
  WHEN request_ms < 500 THEN '250-499 ms'
  WHEN request_ms < 1000 THEN '500-999 ms'
  WHEN request_ms < 2500 THEN '1-2.49 s'
  WHEN request_ms < 5000 THEN '2.5-4.99 s'
  ELSE '>=5 s' END AS latency_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM spans GROUP BY latency_bucket ORDER BY MIN(request_ms)

tiles.title: Frontend Service Inventory
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') AS environment,
  COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') AS service,
  COALESCE("service.version", 'unknown') AS version,
  COALESCE(scope_name, 'unknown') AS scope,
  COUNT(*) AS spans, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY environment, service, version, scope ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Metric Families
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit,
  COUNT(*) AS points, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY metric_name, metric_type, metric_unit ORDER BY metric_name

tiles.title: Metric Record Volume
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  metric_name, COUNT(*) AS points
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY time_bin, metric_name ORDER BY time_bin, metric_name

tiles.title: Telemetry Freshness
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT 'traces' AS signal, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest FROM $trace_dataset
UNION ALL
SELECT 'metrics' AS signal, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest FROM $metrics_dataset
ORDER BY signal

tiles.title: Trace Attribute Coverage
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS spans,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT("page.path") / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS page_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT("http.host") / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS host_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT("http.status_code") / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS status_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(span_trace_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS trace_id_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(span_duration_ns) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS duration_pct
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'

tiles.title: Telemetry Volume
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  'traces' AS signal, COUNT(*) AS records
FROM $trace_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY time_bin
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('5 minutes', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  'metrics' AS signal, COUNT(*) AS records
FROM $metrics_dataset
WHERE COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') ~ '$environment'
  AND COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') ~ '$service'
GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin, signal
